English:
Mirald... Are you really waiting
for a fool like myself...?

He's been all “Mirald...Mirald...” ever since he
stared into the Sword of Time in Early, yeah?

Ohhh, you! It's not very nice
to peep after being asked not to!

I bet you peep on us when we're
changing clothes, you sicko!

I've never done that!
Quit talking crap, you!
EEEK! The Peeping Tom's assaulting me!
Hmhm... Aren't they getting along well now?
